title: The filler's place is saved per check-in and per account (`fillerPlace: { <account>: <place> }`, AS6): two check-ins on one day, one with a place picked for the bank, and an e-wallet in the same check-in with none
story: Set up Mon 4 Jan 2027: the bank holds 300,000, of which Food 30,000 and Free to spend 50,000 (typed); an e-wallet holds 10,000. Pay of 250,000 on the 25th (moved earlier). Tue 12 Jan 09:00, a check-in: the bank shows 295,000 and the person says the 5,000 nobody logged was food; the e-wallet shows 9,000 and they pick nothing for its 1,000. Tue 12 Jan 18:00, a second check-in: the bank shows 293,000 and they pick nothing for the 2,000. Every amount is made up.

events.note: check-in 1: no place for the e-wallet

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 293,000 (bank today) - 25,000 (Food left this period: 30,000 less the 5,000 filler of the first check-in, which the person put on Food; the second check-in's 2,000 picked no place) = 268,000

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 50,000 (Free to spend at the opening) - 1,000 (the e-wallet's filler in the first check-in: no place picked for it) - 2,000 (the bank's filler in the second check-in: no place picked) = 47,000
asks.note: A place picked for one account in one check-in is that account's in that check-in only, not every filler of that day.
